content.adoptionScope: Selected design responsibility documented by merged ADRS #105/#106 and accepted tools README; no claim of active provider enforcement or every package's operational adoption.

content.meaning: govPackageOutput.v1 is a non-authority repo-local packet with nine required files: manifest.json, repo.json, packages.jsonl, assertions.jsonl, receipts.jsonl, readmeProjectionReceipt.jsonl, provider-ci.jsonl, findings.jsonl, admission.jsonl. Its manifest and repo/package/org rows have explicit required digest, identity, class, projection and admission fields; the packet is evidence for a future join and not accepted rule meaning.
content.adoptionScope: Selected design responsibility documented by merged ADRS #105/#106 and accepted tools README; no claim of active provider enforcement or every package's operational adoption.
content.applicability: Governance projection, README, evidence and future final-join surfaces under explicit accepted scope, not product run closure.
conditions: Repo packet must contain manifest.json (repo identity/class, projectionMode and source/output digests); repo.json (repo purpose, non-goals, authority boundary and final gate reference); packages.jsonl (govPackageRow.v1 package id/path/class/purpose/contract/assertion/receipt refs); assertions.jsonl (claims against ADRS-derived contract grants); receipts.jsonl (CI/test/evidence receipts for assertions); readmeProjectionReceipt.jsonl (README projection receipts); provider-ci.jsonl (provider workflow state and adapter evidence); findings.jsonl (expected/actual/delta/likelyOwner/nextAction diagnoses); admission.jsonl (organization-active/stale/orphan/unproven admission rows).

govPackageOutput.v1 fields: kind, repoId, repoClass, projectionMode, sourceDigests[], packageUniverseDigest, packagesDigest, assertionsDigest, receiptsDigest, readmeProjectionDigest, providerCiDigest, findingsDigest, admissionDigest, status, nonAuthority.
govPackageRow.v1 fields: kind, repoId, packageId, packagePath, packageClass, purposeRef, contractRefs[], assertionRefs[], receiptRefs[], readmeProjectionRef, status.
govOrgPackageOutput.v1 fields: kind, orgId, projectionMode, repoOutputDigests[], blockingFindings[], activeCount, nonActiveCount, status.

Input modes must distinguish accepted, proposal-preview and actual provider/repo evidence; sourceDigests and packageUniverseDigest must describe the selection accurately. README packet status does not imply provider enforcement.

satisfaction.description: For selected in-scope repo, a deterministic non-authority govPackageOutput.v1 packet supplies all nine files, manifest identity/projection/digest fields, package rows, assertions, check receipts, README receipts, provider CI state, findings and admission rows; their digest/subject/source mappings can be joined to accepted ADRS grants.

content.responsibility: Stable claim-admission-check CLI: default compile or selftest; forwards exact claim-port compiler output/status, optionally derives active-only official view.

bindings.description: Default compile, selftest, args and dispatch
Calls compiler, forwards streams, branches official view on zero exit
JSONL lanes and fixture proof routines

input.description: main(argv=None) defaults to compile; command choices compile|selftest. --upstream-grants/--grants and --downstream-assertions/--assertions are aliases; compile requires grants, assertions, --receipts, --out; --official-view and --require-active optional. Paths passed to the compiler; absent required flags trigger argparse parser.error before run_compile.
conditions: selftest ignores compile input requirements and runs an isolated fixture path.

output.description: run_compile subprocess [sys.executable, COMPILER, 'compile', '--grants',grants,'--assertions',assertions,'--receipts',receipts,'--out',out,(optional '--require-active')]. Captured compiler stdout/stderr forwarded unmodified; if compiler returncode!=0, return that code before official view. If zero and --official-view set, read admissions from --out, retain rows with admissionResult exactly 'organization-active', copy each record with kind='governance.organizationOfficialView.v1', then write canonical UTF-8 sorted-key compact JSONL with trailing newline per row (empty output for zero matches). selftest runs compiler selftest, creates temporary grants/assertions/receipt and admission/official view fixtures, validates fields, prints a selftest PASS JSON object.

error.description: Missing compile flags -> argparse SystemExit(2); read_jsonl missing file -> SystemExit('missing input'); invalid JSON line or nonobject row -> SystemExit(path:line explanation). Compiler nonzero status is propagated as-is before official-view generation. Compiler subprocess launch, file read/write, value or SystemExit validation failures are not globally swallowed; no claim of all errors mapping to a single code.

effect.description: Calls compiler in a child Python process, forwards captured stdout/stderr, compiler writes caller-selected --out; optional official-view writes file and creates parent dirs; selftest writes/cleans temporary fixtures and launches compiler twice. Only local explicit paths, not external provider mutations.

error.description: Missing CLI flags -> argparse error; invalid JSON or file read errors may throw, non-dict JSON raises SystemExit. validate returns an explanatory error string and main emits stderr/returns1 for wrong status/URI, raw_rows, unknown_policy_inputs, digest/manifest/slot mismatch. content.searchScope: Complete pinned tree 542 entries / tools 183 blobs; candidate public/script paths 85, with 17 representative source entrypoint files read. Accepted ADRS #105/#106 docs and tools README read. Full source-tree path enumeration exists, but semantic export/interface inventory of each tool and all source requirements is not exhaustive. Normative coverage now independently enumerates packet nine-file universe, required manifest/package/org fields, README four projection modes and final-scope nine failure categories, without falsely claiming all tools implement the complete design. Each of the 85 candidate source paths was directly fetched at the pinned base and classified as CLI/command, wrapper, import-only helper, target adapter, shell, Node renderer or declarative target data. Classification is source-path/interface observation, NOT full internal semantic completeness or execution. For many commands, relevant CLI option names are inventoried; unknown per-command error/output conditions remain explicit.
excludedScope: Runtime/CI/provider execution and actual selected final-gate cutover.
